copilotkit/opendots.caption:
OpenDots is a self-hosted template for always-on AI coworkers. Each one gets its own computer, files, and browser.

Ships with:
• Real-time agent status and event inspection
• Drop-in React and Next.js via CopilotKit
• Text, voice calls, and Slack in one thread
• Spaces for docs, with review before
